governance.change_rule: Add, deprecate, or change meanings only through controlled review; preserve stable IDs and map legacy values.

source_mapping: Formal DOCX controls take precedence within their domains.
Settings and center contracts were normalized without treating prototype labels as approved canon.

records.label: Production Manager
records.definition: Accountable for production coordination and controlled-document governance.

records.label: Director
records.definition: Controls approved creative and performance direction.

records.label: Technical Director
records.definition: Controls integrated technical planning and verified technical releases.

records.label: Stage Manager / Show Caller
records.definition: Controls calling, stage-management records, and operational propagation.

records.label: Owner / Performer
records.definition: Project owner role for business and owner-surface decisions; does not replace specialist safety approval.

records.label: Developer
records.definition: Implements data and application mechanics without approving project facts.

records.label: Venue Representative
records.definition: Supplies venue facts and venue-specific operational authority.

records.label: Safety Authority
records.definition: May impose HOLD, STOP, ABORT, or restrictions within assigned competence.

records.label: Privacy Steward
records.definition: Controls restricted personal data handling and retention.

records.label: Rights Reviewer
records.definition: Reviews ownership, license, consent, and permitted-use evidence.

records.label: Accessibility Reviewer
records.definition: Reviews accessibility requirements and evidence.

records.label: Audio / Playback
records.definition: Department role defined by the Supporting Production Documentation Standard: Audio / Playback.
